annotations.title: Remove a format and every row in it

description: Remove a declared format: its declaration, its table and **every row in it**. Refused while another format links to it or folds its rows. The dry run says how many rows go; show that to the user, and call again with `commit: true` only on a plain yes. To remove some rows, use `delete_format_rows` instead.

commit.description: Remove it. Omit or false for the dry run.

format.description: The format to remove, by name.
